thread:
maya: quick sync — copy pass for hosted / dedicated / private pages before launch. key goals: unify headline language, make benchmark narrative short + shareable, set webinar CTA + inbound routing rules. aiming to ship drafts by Fri EOD. thoughts?

olivia: i can do hero variants for each mode. thinking 3 frames: performance, cost, compliance. short lines only.

sam: for launch posts — let's lead with a benchmark (latency/cost) + one customer quote. short tweetable stat pls.

neil: product ask — keep `Hosted API` focused on time-to-value (1-line), `Dedicated` on throughput/SLA, `Private` on security/compliance. avoid heavy jargon.

zarah: webinar idea: "Serving LLMs in production: cost, latency, and control". CTA: "Reserve a seat — see benchmarks live". inbound: route registrants with >50 seats to sales; otherwise marketing nurture.

maya: good. olivia, can you make 3 hero samples and 3 short social copy lines? ex:

olivia: sure — samples below

```
Hosted API — Launch in minutes. Production-grade LLMs, no ops.
Dedicated — Predictable throughput. Reserved GPU capacity and SLAs.
Private — Your network, your keys. On‑prem & VPC-ready.
```

olivia: social lines:
- "New: inference that scales — hosted, dedicated, or private. See benchmarks."
- "Slash per-token cost with smart batching — benchmarks + webinar." :rocket:
- "Need on‑prem inference? Private deployments with KMS & audit logs."

sam: suggest one tweet-sized benchmark stat: "Up to 4× lower per-token cost vs naive hosting w/ caching + batching — tested on common RLHF workloads" — ok to use in posts?

neil: yes but add footnote on workload variability. in copy we can say "up to 4×" and link to benchmark page.

maya: inbound routing rules for registrants: if company_size >= 1000 or interested_in includes 'private' or 'dedicated' -> assign to sales/sdr; else -> nurture sequence (3 emails + invite to on-demand webinar). can we implement using existing forms? cc @announce-bot for tracking.

announce-bot: new form created: /forms/tri-mode-launch. Fields: company_size, interest_tags, email, seats_estimate. webhook -> marketing/leads.

zarah: perfect. can we also add a post-webinar follow up: benchmark PDF + short checklist for infra teams.

maya: yes — assign tasks: olivia hero + social drafts (Thu), sam launch post + stat copy (Thu), neil final product lines + benchmark link (Thu EOD), zarah webinar flow + routing rules (Thu). call if blockers. :handshake:
